description: This PHP source file defines the I18NHelper class, which provides internationalization support functions such as translation retrieval, based on configuration settings, within the OrangeHRM human resource management system.

classes.name: I18NHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing internationalization functions such as translation and language setting, utilizing an internal I18N service.

methods.name: getI18NService
methods.description: Retrieves the I18NService instance from the container.

methods.name: trans
methods.description: Returns a translated string for a given key, considering configuration for internationalization support.

methods.name: transBySource
methods.description: Returns a translation based on a source language string, considering configuration for internationalization support.

methods.name: setTranslatorLanguage
methods.description: Sets the current language for the I18N service translation.
